description:
+ [Important] Before updating, put the site in maintenance mode if possible and take a full backup of your files and database.
+ [Important] Before clicking Update, delete php files inside the bootstrap/cache folder (packages.php, services.php).
+ [Important] Before clicking Update, upload and extract the provided vendor folder (vendor.zip) in your project root, and replace the existing vendor folder. This release upgrades Laravel to version 12 and the vendor folder is no longer included in the update package.
+ [Important] After the update finishes, open yourdomain.com/migration once to complete the database update, then clear the cache using the Clear Cache button.
+[Added] Real-time delivery boy location tracking on the map (Customer App)
+ [Added] Multi-city service support for Delivery Boys (Admin Panel, Partner App)
+ [Added] Abandoned Carts management (Seller Panel, Partner App)
+ [Added] OpenStreetMap integration as an alternative map provider (Admin Panel, Customer App, Partner App)
+ [Added] Arrival countdown for Quick Delivery orders (Customer App)
+ [Added] Voice search for multiple products at once (Customer App)
+ [Added] Product search directly from the home screen (Customer App)
+ [Added] Similar product replacement for out-of-stock cart items (Customer App)
+ [Added] Demo Mode with default credential management through Settings API (Admin Panel)
+ [Added] Admin-wise and Seller-wise Delivery Boy management
+ [Added] Date field type in custom Field options
+ [Added] File upload option in Language Edit module (Admin Panel)
+ [Added] House/Flat Number field in customer addresses (Customer App)
+ [Added] Liquid Glass design support for iOS 26 and later (Customer App)
+ [Updated] Next.js upgraded to version 16.2.4 (Website)
+ [Updated] Laravel framework upgraded to version 12 for improved performance, security, and long-term support (Backend)
+ [Updated] Server-side rendering enabled when SEO is enabled on VPS deployments (Website)
+ [Improved] Combined Cart and Checkout into a single screen (Customer App and Website)
+ [Improved] Customer App state management migrated to Cubit using flutter_bloc (Customer App)
+ [Improved] Centralized API communication through a shared Dio network client (Customer App)
+ [Improved] Safer API data parsing to prevent crashes when server data is missing (Customer App)
+ [Improved] Customer App code organization with a feature-based folder structure (Customer App)
+ [Improved] Shared component for paginated lists (Customer App)
+ [Improved] Deep link configuration centralized for Android and iOS (Customer App)
+ [Improved] Unified map configuration supporting Google Maps and OpenStreetMap (Customer App)
+ [Improved] API debugging logs and automated test coverage (Customer App)
+ [Improved] Partner App location tracking reliability with fewer unnecessary server requests
+ [Improved] Location update and timer cleanup during Partner App logout
+ [Improved] Demo login credentials removed from release builds (Partner App)
+ [Improved] Modern, consistent, and responsive UI across Admin, Seller, and Delivery Boy panels
+ [Improved] Centralized theme colour management through Theme Settings
+ [Improved] System-wide dark mode support
+ [Improved] Arabic language support with proper RTL layouts
+ [Improved] Responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices
+ [Improved] Card and Table view options for listings, with saved view preferences
+ [Improved] Dashboard with key metrics, order status icons, quick actions, stock alerts, top products, and top sellers
+ [Improved] Order details page with a progress tracker, summary cards, and an actions panel
+ [Improved] Header with consistent buttons, language selection, notification badges, sticky layout, and scrolling announcements
+ [Improved] Notifications popup with type-specific icons, unread highlights, and Read All functionality
+ [Improved] Category tree view with drag-and-drop reordering
+ [Improved] Settings page with grouped cards and search functionality
+ [Improved] Standardized Nunito typography, buttons, spacing, borders, and corner radii
+ [Improved] Listing item counts and pagination information
+ [Improved] Session handling to restore the previous page after logging in again
+ [Improved] Text editor support for light and dark modes
+ [Improved] Theme-based module icons and placeholder images for missing pictures
+ [Improved] Browser cache handling to load the latest version after updates
+ [Removed] Unused code, packages, and text keys (Customer App, Partner App)
+ [Fixed] UI inconsistencies and usability issues across Admin, Seller, and Delivery Boy panels
+ [Fixed] Error popups on Store Settings and Popup Offer pages
+ [Fixed] Misaligned icons, compressed dropdowns, and inconsistent button heights
